notes:
Lead from organic doc-search blog post. SMB, customer-facing support docs + internal knowledge base (PDFs, HTML, MS Word). Primary ask: fast, cheap embeddings pipeline + reranking layer to improve support answer relevance. Latency requirement: interactive search 95th pct < 300ms end-to-end for top-k (k=5) in US region. Throughput: 50-150 QPS expected for search peak. Cost sensitivity: wants to keep hosted spend under ~$2k/mo initially.

Technical questions from Eng call: 
- Best-practice chunk size (they currently chunk ~800 tokens) vs recompute cost for embeddings.
- Embedding dim tradeoffs: 1536 vs 768 for open models; impact on rerank cost and ANN storage.
- Reranking approach: use lightweight embedding similarity + lexical signal, or run a 2-stage retrieve+rerank generation? Interested in Redwood's recommendations for 2-pass with reranker model.
- Vector DB integration: will Redwood hosted API play nicely with Pinecone/Weaviate? They want to index in Pinecone but call Redwood for embeddings/reranking; questions re: upsert speed, batching, and idempotency.
- Incremental ingest: how to handle frequent doc updates (delta upserts) and tombstones.

Security/Compliance notes: legal team requires SOC2 evidence and SSO/SAML support; retention policy ability to purge embeddings within 30 days preferred. CTO quote: 'We need predictable unit costs and simple ops—can't babysit infra.'

POC scope (proposed):
- 2-week POC using Hosted API embeddings + Redwood rerank (or open checkpoint recommended)
- Ingest 8-12k support docs (mix PDFs + HTML), measure recall@5 and precision of top answer after rerank
- Validate cost per 10k queries and 95p latency

Stated blockers: legal retention sign-off, confirmation of upsert SLA for large batch ingest, final approval on estimated cost.
